title: Bedside Depth Simulations: rendered bed exits, falls and look-alikes seen by a depth camera in front of a hospital bed

creators.name: TO BE CONFIRMED, family name, given names

description:
62 rendered clips (R01 to R62) of a hospital patient sitting up, leaving the bed, falling (eight kinds) or making look-alike movements (turning in bed, lying back down, sitting on a chair, a blanket or bag on the floor, a nurse kneeling, putting on slippers, walking away), seen by a virtual depth camera on the wall in front of the bed with the fields of view of a Luxonis OAK-D Pro W.

Each clip has a colour video (640 x 480), a grey infrared-like video (640 x 400), a 16-bit depth image per frame (millimetres, planar, ideal), exact event start and end times, per-frame 3D positions of 24 body points with visibility flags, hip height, trunk angle, and both cameras' calibration. Clips R41 to R62 also have the empty room's depth. 7,217 depth frames at 15 frames per second.

The clips come in three sets, each made after a version of simple detection rules was locked; the rules, the body points they read and their results are included as a baseline. Rendered in Blender 4.5.14 with MakeHuman / MPFB bodies (CC0). No real people and no patient data.

Read docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md before use: ideal depth, a pinhole lens that shows people about 45% smaller than the real lens would, and fallen bodies propped on one hand in 17 clips.

A second part holds 52 AI-generated hospital videos from the same camera position (32 Wan 2.2, 16 Veo 3.1 Fast, 4 Seedance 2.0) and the 12 generated start pictures they begin from (Seedream 5.0 Pro), made through fal.ai and released byte for byte as made, with their prompts, settings and a camera-stillness measure. They have no depth, and their labels (the scenario each prompt asked for) have not been checked against the videos.

Files: bedside-depth-sim_v1.0_data.zip (the 3D simulations, CC BY 4.0), bedside-depth-sim_v1.0_generated.zip (the AI-generated part, under its own licence in LICENSE-GENERATED: any use with attribution, kept marked as AI-generated, not for training image or video generation models) and bedside-depth-sim_v1.0_repository.zip (code, baseline and documentation).
notes: 3D simulation data: CC BY 4.0. AI-generated part (data/generated/): its own licence, LICENSE-GENERATED. Code: Apache-2.0, except the Blender scripts in code/render/ (GPL-3.0-or-later).
